deadline_case_in_real_data.how_expiry_is_signalised: the archived block marks a missed deadline as a progress event whose status is NOT completed, carrying detail.expired = true and failure_reason = deadline_expired, at a timestamp one step past the target's deadline
deadline_case_in_real_data.what the collector must therefore do: return without a ledger record and without a credit for those events (its first guard is status is COMPLETED), and the episode's credited total must still equal the lifecycle's on-time count

launch_plan consequence: cases that never occur in any archived cell of this scenario block are recorded as structurally unreachable in the smoke too, and the report must say so instead of claiming coverage
phase_c_method: v2_trainer._bundle itself is asked twice per archived cell: once with the row's legacy task_stream keys, once with every key shifted back one tick. changed_owner_rows lists the action rows whose bundled reward differs, so the attribution footprint is measured by the real bundler rather than a reimplementation. 0 launches, 0 environments.
reproducibility_reasoning: episode 0 of a seed uses exactly Controller(seed) plus the registered action stream sha256('sc-action:{seed}:0'), before any weight has moved, so the fixed collector must replay the same actions, cost stream and event publication order as the archived legacy run and may only differ in the task_stream keys; from batch 0's update onwards the weights depend on the corrected reward, so later cells are indicative only

reproducible_episode_window.consequence_for_the_coverage_claim: same-tick, next-tick-new-action, final-tick and deadline-expiry all occur inside episodes 0..3 (episode 1 carries an expiry), so every case the smoke can claim is also claimable against a reproducible archived cell
reproducible_episode_window.reason: batch 0 rolls all four episodes out with the same untouched Controller(11) and per-episode registered action seeds, and the first weight move happens only after episode 3, so episodes 0..3 of the smoke are byte-comparable with the archived legacy run of the same cell; the only permitted difference is the task_stream key

smoke_launch_plan.launch_1: seed 11, episodes 0..7 uninterrupted: wiring, ledger, per-event table, passivity anchor on episode 0
smoke_launch_plan.launch_2: seed 11, resume from the rolling checkpoint written after episode 4 and continue to episode 8: the real save/restore chain plus continuation equality against launch 1's own episodes 4..7
smoke_launch_plan.reference_cache_source: ROUND24's 64 cached immediate reference rows, read only; the smoke launches no reference cell
smoke_launch_plan.wall_clock_note: archived episodes of this shape take 11.2-14.6 s each, so 8 episodes plus two updates is far inside the 2 h ceiling per launch

unreachable_cases_in_this_block.completion_before_the_first_action: no archived completion was observed before the episode's first decision row (relay ticks start at 1 and the policy decides at tick 1), so the prefix case stays synthetic-only
unreachable_cases_in_this_block.no_action_row_at_the_event_tick: 0 of 4281 archived completion credits landed on a tick without a decision row, so the contract's third row cannot be exercised by real data in this scenario block
